name: rtk
description: CLI proxy that rewrites shell commands so their output reaches the model compressed. Hooks into each harness's pre-tool event through `rtk hook <agent>`. Language-agnostic, so it is declared by the common stack.

prerequisite.summary: rtk-ai rtk >= 1.0.1 on PATH (Homebrew `rtk`, or the Apache-2.0 `rtk-ai/tap/rtk-oss`); POSIX shells only
